tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Consultants/firms/organization with Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Consultants/firms/organization shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Consultants/firms/organization shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of Karnataka Public Procurement portal on or before the last date of bid submission.

Consultants/firms/organization is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Consultants/firms/organization shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
Conditional Request for Proposal will not be accepted.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the Consultants/firms/organization , the Request for Proposal shall liable to be rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.

All the formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Consultants/ firms/ organization. Necessary certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents section can be used for this purpose.
Consultants/firms/organization are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid.

If the numbers of page to be attached in one particular attachment is more, then all the pages can be put into one folder, zipped and then attached or else all the pages can be pasted in one word file and then this word file could be converted to PDF (portable documents format) format and then attached. (Please contract Help Desk for more assistance Phone: 080-25501216/ 25501227)

The Consultants/firms/organation are bound to furnish the original certified documents to the employer within a week s time from the day of opening of technical bid for verification failing which the Request for Proposal will be considered as non responsive.
All other terms and conditions are applicable as per the request for proposal.
The Consultants/firms/organization shall submit FINANCIAL PROPOSAL SUBMISSION FORM , SUMMARY OF COSTS,BREAKDOWN OF COSTS only after opening of Financial bids to the Employer.
Consultants/firms/organization shall secure a minimum Technical score of 85 points to Qualify
Consultant will be selected under Quality- and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) procedure

The Technical Proposal shall not include any financial information other than the specified technical criteria in the RFP. Bid will be treated Technically Non Responsive if technical proposal includes any financial submission forms.

To qualify for the award of the consultancy services, each consultant/ firm in its name should have in the last 5 years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved at least in two year a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 34.60 Lakhs (in Consultancy Services Only) (The financial Turnover of the previous shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to 2026-27 price level). The Annual financial Turnover Certificate and certified copies of IT returns, audit report, profit and loss statement etc., balance sheet, shall be issued by the registered Chartered Accountant with UDIN No.
The amount quoted by the Consultants shall be Excluding GST & inclusive of all other applicable taxes.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Specific experience of the consultants related Assignment (Atleast two similar Hospital nature of work Such as preparation of plans & estimates of buildings including services such as plumbing, internal electrification, fire fighting, HVAC etc., and Architectural, Structural and other services Drawings (Minimum Project cost of Value each Rs. 1075.00 Lakhs) The completion certificate should have been issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of Government, Semi Government or Autonomous bodies of State or Central Government. Note: Hospital Buildings (10 points each) 20 points Other buildings (05 points each) - 10 points
Adequacy of the proposed work plan and methodology
Master plan, Overall Building Design Approach, Study of surrounding developments, Building Design and elevation, Environment study of storm water and sewage disposal as per NBC & IPHS Norms.

Qualifications and competence of the key professional staff (CV of 1 Team Leader 1 Deputy Team Leader(Architect), 1 Structural Engineer, 1 Quantity Surveyor,1 Mechanical Engineer, 1 Electrical & 1 PHE Engineer) will be considered) for detailed marks allocation refer Annexure - C-a) Qualification-10 points, b)Experience to related project-14,c)Experience in region and language-6-Total 30
Should have certificate of ISO 9001:2015 Certificate for providing Architectural and Structural Design Services
